threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You can spot a new face when they look baffled by the bus service after 9 PM; locals know to rely on night buses or just walk it.
Last night on the 59, a guy was loudly reciting Shakespeare. Brixton's night bus passengers are wilder than you'd think, Shakespeare included.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I spotted a couple haggling over antique vinyls at the Sunday market, while kids danced to a street musician's tune. That's Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin can you grab a currywurst from a vendor while dodging trams, all in the shadow of an East Side Gallery mural. It's a chaotic art walk!

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can tell a local by how they navigate the BART delays; they’ve figured out which coffee shop to hit before heading home to avoid the chaos.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy in a full tuxedo giving a speech to an empty 38 bus yesterday. Only in SF do you get pre-wedding jitters on the Muni.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think all bars serve tapas after 11 PM; locals know that most kitchens close by 10.30 and that the real vibe is found in the late-night vermut spots.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell they’re recent by the way they stare blankly at the Metro map, still not used to the labyrinth of lines.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You know you're new when you still think the 'Overground' means a paved path, not a whole different layer of transport chaos.
Last night on the 35, a guy serenaded us with an old Elvis tune, while a cat sat on the aisle—perfectly unbothered.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The day I heard a toddler bargaining over ice cream with the Kiosk owner while the father just laughed. That's Neukölln for you.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Friedrichshain will you find spontaneous techno parties in abandoned buildings, complete with artisanal vegan food stalls and retro arcade games.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know they're from SF if they instinctively dodge the guy selling roses by the BART station without breaking stride.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy serenading the Muni platform with a ukulele while waiting for the N. Took me back to simpler days—nothing like live music amidst the chaos.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists always think the squares are just for pictures, but locals actually use them for gatherings, games, and late-night chats. It's our heartbeat.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can always tell by the way they try to order a cortado and end up with a sweetened café con leche instead.
